findings.what: Three message keys are defined but never referenced by any component in the diff (checked via grep across knowledge-firm-panel.tsx, knowledge-promote-dialog.tsx, knowledge-exception.tsx). `exceptionOpen` duplicates the namespaced `promote.openRegister`/`exception.openRegister` that are actually used; `inForce`/`clientOnly` look like vestigial copy for states `KnowledgeExceptionPair` no longer renders (the component only shows entries where `in_force === "client_exception" && firm_rule !== null`, so the pure-firm-default and pure-client-only cases never reach these strings).
findings.evidence: `grep -oE 't\("[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+"' apps/web/components/registers/knowledge-firm-panel.tsx apps/web/components/registers/knowledge-promote-dialog.tsx apps/web/components/registers/knowledge-exception.tsx` never yields `exceptionOpen`, `inForce`, or `clientOnly`; `check-message-keys.mjs` (run via `pnpm lint`, exit 0) only checks that used keys resolve, not that defined keys are used, so this doesn't fail CI.
findings.fix: Either wire the two exception-state strings into `KnowledgeExceptionPair` for completeness, or delete the three orphaned keys so a future reader doesn't assume they're live copy.
